interpretations: Films with `length >= 112`: return one row containing their average `length`, then the average of each film’s `replacement_cost / rental_rate`.
Films with `length > 112`: return one row containing their average `length`, then the average of each film’s `replacement_cost / rental_rate`.
queries:
SELECT
  AVG(length) AS average_length,
  AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) AS average_cost_to_rate_ratio
FROM film
WHERE length >= 112

SELECT
  AVG(length) AS average_length,
  AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) AS average_cost_to_rate_ratio
FROM film
